headline: Key classes and functions in DOM module
why: The DOMNode class is foundational for the Textual Document Object Model, affecting multiple components like Widgets and Screens. Changes to this file can disrupt the functionality of many dependent modules.
checklist: Review changes to DOMNode class and its methods.
Check the implementation of check_identifiers function for validation logic.
Ensure that any modifications to exceptions like BadIdentifier do not affect error handling.
Verify the impact of changes on the ReactiveType and its usage.
